question: Where did Neeraj Chopra achieve his national record throw of 90.23 m in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Doha Diamond League**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra**, India's ace javelin thrower, achieved his national record throw of **90.23 meters** during the **Doha Diamond League** event held in **2025**.
 
• The **Doha Diamond League** is an international athletics event that serves as one of the prestigious meets in the **Diamond League series**, which attracts elite athletes from across the globe.
 
• The record-breaking performance by Neeraj Chopra at the Doha Diamond League further solidified his position as one of the leading javelin throwers globally and marked a **historic milestone for Indian athletics**.
 
• Neeraj Chopra's **throw of 90.23 meters** surpassed his previous best and demonstrated his consistent improvement in technique, strength, and performance.
 
• The event was conducted under the **World Athletics regulations**, ensuring the accuracy and legitimacy of the recorded distances.
 
• This achievement not only showcased Neeraj Chopra's exceptional skill but also highlighted India's growing presence in international athletics competitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra's Career Highlights:**

 
 
• Neeraj Chopra became a global sensation after winning the **gold medal in javelin throw** at the **Tokyo Olympics 2021**, making him the first Indian to achieve this feat in athletics.
 
• He also won the **gold medal** at the **Commonwealth Games 2018** held in Gold Coast, Australia.
 
• His consistent performances have earned him accolades such as the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**, India's highest sporting honor.
 
• Neeraj Chopra has been a prominent figure in popularizing athletics in India and inspiring young athletes to pursue sports at an international level.
 
 
 
• **Doha Diamond League:**
 
 
• The **Doha Diamond League** is part of the **Diamond League series**, which is an annual series of elite track and field competitions organized by **World Athletics**.
 
• Held in **Doha, Qatar**, the event attracts top athletes from around the globe and serves as a platform for world-class performances.
 
• The competition is known for its high-quality facilities and favorable conditions for athletes, making it ideal for record-breaking performances.
 
 
 
• **Javelin Throw in Athletics:**
 
 
• The javelin throw is a **track and field event** where athletes aim to throw a spear-like implement, known as a javelin, as far as possible.
 
• The sport requires a combination of **strength, speed, and technique** for optimal performance.
 
• The javelin used in international competitions must meet specific specifications set by **World Athletics**, including its weight, length, and balance.
 
 
 
• **Indian Athletics Achievements:**
 
 
• India has made significant strides in athletics, with athletes like **Neeraj Chopra, Hima Das, and Anju Bobby George** earning recognition on the global stage.
 
• Government initiatives such as **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** have played a crucial role in supporting elite athletes.
 
• India's improved performance in athletics is a testament to the growing investment in sports infrastructure, coaching, and training programs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Javelin Specifications:** The javelin used in international competitions must weigh **800 grams** for men and **600 grams** for women and should be made of **metal or composite material**.
 
• **Neeraj Chopra's Training:** He trains under world-class coaches and utilizes advanced techniques and equipment to enhance his performance.
 
• **Performance Metrics:** Key factors influencing a javelin throw include the **angle of release, speed, and grip technique**.
 
• **World Record:** The current world record for men's javelin throw is held by **Jan Železný** of the Czech Republic, with a throw of **98.48 meters** in 1996.
